title: Australia will impose mandatory safety rules on AI. Are we focused on the right risks?
paragraphs: Prime Minister Anthony Albanese has just announced six mandatory artificial intelligence (AI) safety guardrails.
The government will establish a new AI safety regulator to enforce the regulations, with the power to impose significant penalties.
